verdict.rationale: Simular documents a programmatic interface for embedding computer control in your own code. It offers the Sai API (`POST /v1/agents/message` over HTTPS, plus a `/v1/agents/approve` endpoint for approval flows) and a Python SDK. It also ships simulang-js and the open-source Agent-S framework. Tasks run on hosted cloud computers or the user's own Mac/Windows device. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/reference spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of embedding the SDK/API in a third-party app.
